Aquatic groups

Local nonprofit groups share the pools with the city's own programs. Here is when each is in the water this fall; the calendar has every session. Contacts for each group are on the city's Aquatic Groups page.

Irvine Novaquatics

Swim team.

Every weekday afternoon in the Competition Pool (3–8pm, most of the pool from 4 to 6), Diving Pool evenings, Northwood 5–9pm, and the Teaching Pool 3:30–6pm.

Nova Masters

Adult swimmers. Practice schedule.

Competition Pool weekdays 5:45–8am and 11am–1pm; weekends 8–9:15am in the Diving Pool or at Northwood.

Concordia University Irvine

Water polo and swimming.

Diving Pool weekdays 6–9am; swimming in the Competition Pool Tuesday to Friday 1–3pm; home matches listed on the calendar.

Irvine Unified School District

Irvine High and Northwood High.

Northwood on school days 6am–5pm; Diving Pool weekdays 2–4:30pm; home games on the calendar.

Crean Lutheran High School

Water polo.

Competition Pool weekdays 1:30–4pm.

Meraquas of Irvine

Artistic swimming.

Diving Pool Monday and Wednesday 6–8pm and weekend mornings; Northwood some Fridays.

Irvine Kahuna Water Polo and North Irvine Water Polo

Youth water polo clubs; Kahuna hosts the Evan Cousineau Cup in October.

Diving Pool weekday evenings 4:30–8pm and Northwood 5–9pm (listed as POLO on the city's sheet).

Underwater Hockey

Monday and Wednesday 8–9:15pm.
